description: Get bounded EA water-quality observations for a sampling_point notation, dates and optional determinand code. Preserves reported units and detection-limit qualifiers (OGL v3). Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

determinand.description: Optional numeric EA determinand code to select the measured substance or property.

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no earlier than start, at most 366 days apart.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no later than end, at most 366 days apart.

name: wq_measurements
